meaning:
1) to move slowly
1a) (Hithpael) to walk deliberately

elsewhere.note: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a…
What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
